note: BH-5795: 1 holds a lead review request for a head CI never tested: a DIRTY PR (GitHub runs no CI on it), or a PR whose base is not the default branch with no LEAD_REVIEW_TRACED_JOB check run that ran (none, all skipped, or unreadable). It protects the lead from reviewing a head no suite ran on: 22 review BLOCKs said exactly that (#4189..#5395). The hold dispatches LEAD_REVIEW_TRACED_WORKFLOW with scope=impact on the head branch once, and lasts at most LEAD_REVIEW_TRACED_MAX_WAIT_MIN; then the head is requested with the note `tests did not run`. Each firing costs that wait, at most. A PR on the default branch is never held: the merge-queue batch tests it. 0 = request as before. Moved from the retired lead-review-enqueue lane (BH-5878): the worklist gates read it.
